info.name: Physics Data Entry Portal
info.description:
Run top to bottom (Collection Runner) or request by request.
1. "Teacher login" stores the CSRF token; Postman keeps the HttpOnly session cookie automatically.
2. "Classes and sections" stores sectionId; "Create academic year" stores academicYearId (change {{yearLabel}} if the year exists); "Add student" stores enrollmentId.
3. Every non-GET request sends X-CSRF-Token: {{csrfToken}}.
4. The import preview needs you to choose a .xlsx/.csv file in the "file" field; skip the import requests in a runner.
5. The last folder logs in as a student (Student ID only) and is read-only.
The teacher name and Student ID in the bodies match the seed data from the README; change them to yours.

request.description: If the teacher has an optional passcode, the API answers PASSCODE_REQUIRED; repeat with "passcode".
Optional hardening. Signs out this teacher's other sessions.
The first year becomes active; later ones start as planned.
Choose a .xlsx or .csv file in the "file" field (max 5 MB, 5000 rows).
skipInvalid=true imports the valid rows and skips rows with errors. The token is single-use and expires after 30 minutes.

Omit a field to leave it unchanged, send null to clear it, send 0 for a real zero. "version" is the record version you loaded (0 when there is none); a stale version answers CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION. Finalized records and closed years need "correctionReason".
